Definition: of Hebrew origin (H499); Eleazar, an Israelite:--Eleazar.
BiblicalUsage: Eleazar is an Israelite. In Matthew 1:15, the text says "And Eliud begat Eleazar."
TheologicalSignificance: I take eleázar as it stands: Eleazar.
